paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah bar Chananyah: Sifrei, Haazinu, beginning of chapter 1.
Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah, the well-known sage.
Rabbi Yose ben Chananyah: Kohelet Rabbah 5:10.
Rabbi Yishmael ben Chananyah: Avot deRabbi Natan, chapter 14.
Rabbi Pinchas ben Chananyah: Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim, beginning of chapter 2.
Rabbi Shmuel ben Chananyah: Jerusalem Talmud Yoma, chapter 5, halakhah 4.

notes.text: This notice groups people whose fathers are called Chananyah. It does not establish that all those fathers were one person. The consulted Sanhedrin 101a names Shimon ben Chananya.
